implemented_capabilities.notes: Pure Python (no DB imports). Shifts PLANNED shipments inside an outage window, allocates lots oldest-first by order deadline/priority, flags at-risk vs insufficient_data, then runs a bounded greedy mitigation over cost_first/lead_first/per-supplier policies with certificate-valid-at-arrival checks. Assumptions are explicitly listed; it is not an optimizer.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Graph snapshot normalization with data-quality issues and content fingerprint
implemented_capabilities.notes: Converts falkordb Node/Edge objects into strictly validated facts; any missing/invalid property becomes a DataIssue and downgrades results to insufficient_data rather than guessing. The sha256 fingerprint of the operational subgraph is used as a revision token.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Approval gating with stale-preview detection, idempotency and archived evidence snapshot
implemented_capabilities.notes: Approve re-runs the simulation and rejects (409 stale_preview) if operational fingerprint, scenario_id or plan_revision hash differ from what the operator reviewed. Requires bearer secret (hmac.compare_digest), operator_id, rationale, explicit confirm flag and idempotency key; writes Decision + Evidence(snapshot_json) + SUPPORTED_BY/SELECTS/AFFECTS/REFERENCES edges in one Cypher statement. Internal decision only; no real action.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Read-only MCP tool server over the graph
implemented_capabilities.notes: Six typed read-only tools (graph_summary, trace_supplier_impact, evaluate_part_alternatives, simulate_supply_disruption, get_decision_history, resolve_evidence), 32 KiB result cap, pagination, all annotated read_only_hint.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Bounded LLM tool coordinator with grounded rendering
implemented_capabilities.notes: Model may only pick registry tools; scenario args are checked against the operator's scenario (scenario_mismatch). Final prose is rendered by the app from simulation facts (grounded_answer); LLM output is only a typed selection. OpenAI provider is opt-in (allow_paid_calls) and default is a no-LLM guided walkthrough.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Dependency path tracing (supplier -> part -> product -> order)
implemented_capabilities.notes: Fixed 3-hop Cypher pattern over SUPPLIES{is_primary}/USES/CONTAINS; not a generic variable-depth traversal.

graph_models_and_cypher: FalkorDB graph 'rippleproof'. Node labels: Supplier, Part, Product, Order, Certificate, InboundShipment (operational); Decision, Evidence (memory). Edges: SUPPLIES{is_primary,unit_cost,lead_days,daily_capacity}, USES, CONTAINS, REQUIRES_CERT, HOLDS_CERT{valid_until}, FULFILLS, FOR_PART, and Decision edges SELECTS, AFFECTS, SUPPORTED_BY, REFERENCES. Every relationship carries a stable string id property (does not rely on FalkorDB internal IDs). Cypher is a reviewed allowlist in queries.py with all user values passed as params; reads use GRAPH.RO_QUERY; seed uses UNWIND/MERGE; SAVE_DECISION is a single multi-clause MERGE/FOREACH statement. No APOC/GDS.
algorithms: Outage-window shipment shifting preserving transit time (engine.py:timeline)

Bounded greedy mitigation across cost_first/lead_first/supplier:<id> policies with protected-on-time-order constraint and rank by (restored desc, unused units, cost, suppliers) (engine.py:mitigate, propose)
SHA-256 content fingerprint of normalized subgraph as optimistic-concurrency/stale token (snapshot.py:normalize)
Plan revision hash and idempotent decision identity from sha256(graph,key) (decisions.py:digest, approve)
backend_interfaces: FastAPI: GET /health, graph summary, impact paths, alternatives, POST simulate scenario, agent capabilities, POST agent run, POST prepare decision, POST approve decision (Bearer), GET decision/{id}, GET decisions history
MCP stdio server (rippleproof.mcp_server) with 6 read-only tools
frontend_interfaces: React/Vite/TS: Overview, ScenarioForm, Comparison, OutcomeDetails, EvidenceExplorer, GraphCanvas (Cytoscape), MaterialInspector, DecisionReview, Ledger, PlanDetails, AgentPanel
agent_or_memory_mechanisms: Decision memory is graph-native: approved internal decisions persist as Decision nodes with archived Evidence snapshot_json and fingerprint, queryable via get_decision_history/resolve_evidence. Agent mode is a bounded MCP tool loop (max 6 turns / 8 tool calls / 90 s) with model-supplied args validated against the operator scenario; guided mode needs no LLM.
tests_present: ~100 test functions: unit (test_simulation 20, test_validation 8, test_agent_provider 7, test_provider_telemetry 7, test_seed_data 4, others) plus integration tests requiring a live FalkorDB (test_mcp_agent 16, test_simulation 13, test_decisions 11, test_graph 10, test_fingerprint 2); frontend vitest + playwright e2e (approval, workspace, agent, restart).
dependency_requirements: OpenAI API key only if agent provider enabled (opt-in)
security_findings: RIGHTS.md - NO open-source license; all rights reserved, public source for hackathon review only. Reuse is legally blocked absent the owner's written permission (user-attested only).
rippleproof/decisions.py:~101-110 - approval uses Bearer secret with hmac.compare_digest (positive); secret is min 32 chars via SecretStr in config.py

rippleproof/decisions.py:~97-99 - APPROVAL_LOCK is a process-local threading.RLock; comment itself notes it does not protect against other API processes/external DB writers (concurrency gap in multi-worker deployments)
rippleproof/provider.py - outbound HTTPS only to OpenAI Responses endpoint when explicitly enabled (allow_paid_calls); 'no arbitrary endpoints' by design
scripts/release_candidate.py:149,159,163,166 and scripts/verify_clean_install.py:88,118,171 - subprocess with list args (no shell=True); dev/release scripts only
No eval/exec/pickle in rippleproof/; Cypher is allowlisted constants with bound params (no string concatenation of user input)
duplicates_or_overlaps: Overlaps Supply Chain & Logistics blast-radius traversal (supplier->part->order dependency paths) and disruption/what-if simulation. The approval-with-fingerprint pattern overlaps Hemu585/campaign-context-agent revision CAS approval.
evidence_drift_relevance: HIGH - stale_preview invalidation via sha256 snapshot fingerprint + plan_revision, archived Evidence snapshot per decision, idempotent approval with operator rationale, and certificate expiry-at-arrival checks directly model dependency invalidation and approval gating; lacks source supersession/versioning.

strongest_reusable_unit.why: Compact stale-preview/approval gate: recompute under lock, compare fingerprint and plan hash, require idempotency + rationale + confirm, archive the evidence snapshot atomically in the graph. The simulation/engine.py is a separate pure-Python, DB-free engine.
strongest_reusable_unit.external_runtime_needed: FalkorDB for decisions/queries; none for simulation/engine.py; OpenAI key only for optional agent mode. LICENSE BLOCKER: no license granted.

strategy_rationale: Supply-disruption simulation and the fingerprint-gated approval flow are real and self-contained, but are domain-specific (parts/orders/certificates) and the repo carries an all-rights-reserved notice, so reuse needs documented owner permission; port the approval/fingerprint pattern into Kairos and keep the supply simulation as an optional logistics pack.
